status: UNEXECUTED hypothesis; no new model, features, thresholds, training or native jobs implemented in this trial

legacy_failure.interpretation: The inherited median accepts at 64 despite disagreement from the learned mean; guarding only new learned actions leaves these decisions untouched.

remaining_false_rejections.interpretation: The last case is outside current learning scope. ADDI after sign placement discards known bits in the current conservative representation.

hypothesis: Treat the whole acceptance-lowering pipeline as a single audited decision policy. Test whether legacy median proposals need independently learned corroboration before lowering release, with release as fallback; combine this with new training coverage and a sound localized width representation for add-immediate after narrow sign placement. No blanket assertion that either frozen fallback is safe.
representation_proposal: Before new labels, preregister conservative bit-by-bit known-zero/known-one carry propagation for ADD/ADDI (especially narrow high-position data plus small constants), in a NEW helper under scripts. Current frozen helper and models stay immutable. Soundness tests must compare masks against exact RV32 evaluation; precision recovery is not itself an area guarantee.

training_proposal.purpose: Novel Boolean sharing, repeated post-add logic, narrow sign-placement-before/after-add and previously out-of-scope outer-input contrasts, balanced with high-cost cases. Do not fit any consumed evaluation label.
training_proposal.matched_ablation: If used, freeze coverage-only versus new localized-representation fit order and selection before labels; no margin or seed grid.

validation: Freeze a new finite cohort and all proposal/corroboration/fallback rules before features/labels. Measure complete general, supported-action, mandatory unsupported and legacy-disagreement populations separately, with predeclared activation minima and retained controls. Retain all current panels, every named safe correction and all false-acceptance counterexamples. Accuracy/tail must preserve exact frozen comparators; FA<=release and FR<=signed separately32/64/128. No pooled success, postlabel subset, pool extension or numerical cap-margin tweak.
limitations: This is a postlabel mechanistic hypothesis, not a passing policy or a claim that release/learned corroboration already satisfies all gates. Current experiment remains scientifically ineligible and the goal active.
